project.title: Launch of Unified B2B Service Bundles
project.objective: Design and launch a unified portfolio of B2B service bundles with clear pricing, SLAs, and go-to-market plan to increase uptake and simplify sales.
deliverables: Defined catalog of B2B service bundles with features and SLAs
Pricing and discount structure with margin analysis
Launch readiness checklist and sign-off report
constraints: Launch date fixed to upcoming quarterly sales kick-off
Must maintain or improve current gross margin targets
Compliance with existing company policies and legal standards
Limited budget for external agencies and consultants
Bundles must be operable within current ERP and billing systems

risks.risk: Pricing misaligned with market expectations leading to low adoption.
risks.mitigation: Run quick market benchmarking and pilot pricing review with sales and finance before final sign-off.

risks.risk: Operational teams not ready to deliver new bundles at launch.
risks.mitigation: Create detailed launch readiness checklist and secure sign-off from operations and support leads.

risks.risk: Suppliers unable to meet new SLA requirements in bundles.
risks.mitigation: Engage key suppliers early, negotiate updated terms, and define fallback options for critical components.

risks.risk: Scope creep adding too many bundle variants and delaying launch.
risks.mitigation: Freeze MVP bundle list by mid-project and park additional ideas in a post-launch roadmap.

themes.why_relevant: Core to deciding which services are grouped, target segments, and value proposition.
Ensures bundles are competitive while meeting financial targets and budget constraints.
External partners must support SLAs, capacity, and cost structure of new bundles.
Drives awareness and adoption across direct and indirect sales channels.
Keeps cross-functional work on track to hit the fixed launch date.

backlog.task: Define target customer segments and initial list of B2B service bundles
definition_of_done: Customer segments documented and agreed with sales
Initial bundle list with high-level features drafted
Scope validated with project manager and logged in project plan

backlog.task: Detail features, SLAs, and dependencies for each bundle
definition_of_done: Feature and SLA matrix completed for all bundles
Operational feasibility reviewed with delivery teams
Dependencies and assumptions captured in bundle catalog

backlog.task: Develop pricing model and margin analysis for bundles
definition_of_done: Cost inputs validated with finance
Pricing tiers and discounts defined per segment
Margin analysis approved by finance controller

backlog.task: Create supplier engagement and outsourcing adjustment plan
definition_of_done: Key suppliers and outsourced services mapped to bundles
Required SLA and contract changes identified
Engagement timeline aligned with overall project plan

backlog.task: Produce go-to-market and channel marketing strategy
definition_of_done: Positioning statements and key messages drafted
Channel tactics and content plan outlined
Sales and marketing leadership sign-off obtained

backlog.task: Set up and maintain integrated project plan and RAID log
definition_of_done: Project schedule created with milestones and owners
Risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies logged
Weekly status reporting cadence agreed with stakeholders

backlog.task: Validate ERP and billing readiness for new bundles
definition_of_done: Impacts on ERP and billing identified with internal teams
Required configuration changes documented
Go/no-go criteria for systems readiness defined

backlog.task: Draft internal product and service description sheets for sales
definition_of_done: One-pagers created for each bundle with benefits and FAQs
Reviewed with sales enablement and adjusted as needed
Final versions stored in shared repository and linked in channel

backlog.task: Plan and run cross-functional launch readiness review
definition_of_done: Readiness checklist completed by all functional leads
Open gaps and owners documented
Formal launch go/no-go decision recorded

backlog.task: Define post-launch performance KPIs and tracking approach
definition_of_done: KPIs for adoption, revenue, and churn agreed with stakeholders
Data sources and reporting cadence defined
Initial 90-day review plan documented

backlog.task: Align internal communication plan for launch
definition_of_done: Key internal audiences identified
Communication timeline and channels defined
Draft messages aligned with marketing and HR communications

backlog.task: Consolidate lessons learned and backlog for bundle iteration
definition_of_done: Feedback from sales, support, and customers collected
Improvement items prioritized into a post-launch backlog
Summary shared with stakeholders and stored with project docs

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on target segments and final MVP bundle list.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff discussion after initial market and customer analysis is shared.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the list of target customer segments for the first launch.
Freeze the MVP bundle list and park additional ideas for later waves.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Converge on pricing, discounts, and margin guardrails.
threads_plan.trigger: Pricing model draft is uploaded for review and comments.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on target margin range and discount rules for each bundle.
Sign off the initial price list for inclusion in sales materials.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Lock supplier engagement steps and system readiness scope.
threads_plan.trigger: Project manager posts updated project plan and supplier impact summary.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm which supplier contracts must be updated before launch.
Agree on ERP and billing readiness criteria for go/no-go.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Finalize go-to-market plan and sales enablement materials.
threads_plan.trigger: Draft GTM playbook and sales one-pagers are shared for feedback.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the GTM plan and key launch campaigns.
Confirm final versions of sales one-pagers for distribution.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Run launch readiness check and define post-launch follow-up.
threads_plan.trigger: One week before launch, project manager initiates readiness review.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Reconfirm go/no-go decision based on readiness checklist and risks.

channel_rituals: Daily async standup post with yesterday-today-blockers format.
Twice-weekly status update from project manager summarizing plan, risks, and decisions.
Weekly go-to-market checkpoint focused on messaging, content, and sales readiness.
Pre-launch readiness huddle thread using the launch checklist for sign-offs.
Post-launch 30-day review thread to capture KPIs and lessons learned.
